messages:
alex_k: Quick sync — we need to land a concrete mapping from runtime signals to dashboard panels for the new reliability view. Who owns mapping of fallback vs degraded_mode counts?

maria_g: I can take the ownership of mapping, but will need runtime schema from eng-runtime. cc @jamie_s for KV cache and fallback tags.

jamie_s: FYI the runtime emits: `request.timeout`, `response.5xx`, `oom.event`, `fallback.triggered`, `degraded_mode.entered`. But some of these are emitted at different layers (proxy vs model-server).

samir_p: important: `fallback.triggered` is bubbled only when we actually return fallback content. degraded_mode.entered is internal and might not always correlate 1:1.

alex_k: That's the crux — product wants a single "failure rate" metric for SLIs but we need to be explicit in dashboards. Suggest panels: 5xx rate, timeout rate, OOM count, fallback rate, degraded-mode activations.

product_ana: For SLAs we care about user-facing failures. Can we derive an aggregated "user_error_rate" that is 5xx + timeouts + fallback-that-returned-error? Excluding internal degrade entries that had successful fallback.

jamie_s: We can attribute a boolean `user_impact` on each request at the API gateway stage. Runtime can set it true when response status != 200 or we served a fallback payload flagged `fallback.user_visible=true`.

maria_g: Is adding `user_impact` a breaking schema change? We should avoid churn for older dashboards. Maybe emit it as optional tag for a rollout window.

alex_k: Rollout plan: start as opt-in header from gateway -> runtime mirrors it -> dashboards read it. devex to coordinate SDK and console UX for toggling.

devex_l: I can add a "show user-impact only" toggle on the reliability dashboard. Also want to add a tooltip explaining the difference between fallback vs degraded_mode.

samir_p: One open debate: should degraded_mode activations be counted as failures? Ops says count them as signal but not as SLO breaches.

product_ana: Agree — degraded_mode is a quality signal but not always user visible. We need both counts side-by-side and a computed SLO metric that excludes non-user-impacting degraded events.

jamie_s: Implementation detail: prefix tags like `rt.layer=proxy|model` and `rt.cause=timeout|oom|mem_pressure|routing_quota`. That helps pivoting in dashboards.

maria_g: Also propose deriving a materialized metric `fallback_reason` with cardinality cap (top 10 reasons) so dashboards don't explode.

alex_k: Good call. For quotas: quota-denied requests currently return 429 at gateway. Should quota_denied be a separate panel? Product requests to correlate quota spikes with degraded_mode.

samir_p: Yes — add `quota.denied` counter and include `quota.bucket` label. We'll need privacy checks before exposing bucket IDs in public dashboards.

devex_l: UX note: when we surface correlated heatmaps (quota spikes vs OOMs) want inline timepicker sync and a "correlate" button that draws lines between series.

alex_k: Action items: (1) jamie to add telemetry tags (rt.layer, rt.cause, user_impact, fallback.user_visible) — target rollout next week. (2) maria to produce mapping doc that links runtime signals -> dashboard panels. (3) devex to mock dashboard toggles and tooltip copy. (4) samir to add quota.denied metric and confirm privacy constraints.

jamie_s: I'll open a PR for telemetry changes and include migration notes.

maria_g: I'll draft the mapping doc in docs/telemetry and ping for review by EOD Thurs.

devex_l: I'll post mock screenshots in #eng-design by Friday.

sre_bot: deploy-notice: telemetry PR must include metrics schema bump and feature flag.

alex_k: Thanks all. If we can get telemetry changes behind a feature flag we can start dashboard dev without breaking prod. Follow up thread for rollout cadence if needed. :thumbsup:

product_ana: One more thing — include a short example query for the SLO metric in the mapping doc, e.g.:

```
user_error_rate = (sum(5xx) + sum(timeouts) + sum(fallback_user_visible)) / sum(total_requests)
```
Keep it simple.

samir_p: noted. I'll validate the raw counters and ensure label cardinality is limited.

alex_k: closing the loop — will schedule a 30m sync if anyone hits blockers tomorrow. Thanks!
